summary_rationale: Azad Engineering possesses a genuine, hard-to-replicate engineering moat: 1,700+ OEM-qualified rotating airfoils and mission-critical turbine/aero components, ~₹6,500 Cr rolling order book (~10-11x annual sales), 37.3% consolidated operating margins in FY26 (38.0% TTM Sep 2026), and six newly commissioned dedicated OEM facilities (44,800 sq. m.) for MHI, GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, and Baker Hughes. However, accounting profits have not yet translated into free cash flow: FY26 delivered -₹119 Cr CFO (-31% CFO/EBITDA) and -₹691 Cr FCF, driven by 189 debtor days, 2,067 inventory days (304 working capital days), and ₹572 Cr capex that compressed ROCE from 22% (FY22) to 12% (FY25-FY26) while lifting borrowings to ₹578 Cr by Sep 2026. Until delta qualifications at the new plants convert inventory into cash collections and pull working capital down toward management's 160-180 day H2 FY27 target, the business warrants a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL quality verdict with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health.
